pages.text: After advanced dungeons, continue into the $(thing)Iron Citadel$() and then the $(thing)Obsidian Abyss$(). These expeditions add original rooms and stronger enemies. Bring good armor, a ranged weapon, healing supplies and a Homeward Pearl.

The $(thing)Iron Citadel$() requires its own key, found in hard Advanced treasure. Expect pillars, crossfire and locked treasuries. Separate groups of enemies, use cover and find the guardian carrying the chest key.

The $(thing)Obsidian Abyss$() requires a key from a locked Citadel treasury. It adds more dangerous groups, raised crossings and pits with recovery routes. Inspect the route before fighting and leave room to retreat.

Both expedition keys are already $(thing)activated$(). Insert them into an upgraded portal with two crowns and white or purple banners. A key always leads to its own address: use another key to start a new expedition.

The normal Dimensional Dungeons building and breaking restrictions apply. A $(item)Homeward Pearl$() returns to the current dungeon entrance; the portal leads home. These expeditions are optional and never gate technology quests.
